title: A PHP config backup is served (/config.php.bak)
summary: A backup of a PHP config file is downloadable as source, which commonly carries the database credentials and application secrets in plain text.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("<?php") and (body_contains("password") or body_contains("DB_") or body_contains("DATABASE")) and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Remove the backup from the web root and rotate any secrets it carried.
